lockbox.name: Edna's lockbox
lockbox.blurb: A mag-lock with its power cell knocked loose. Turn the conduits until the line runs from the cell to the lock.
lockbox.solvedText: The mag-lock thunks open. Edna doesn't look up: "Took you long enough."

airlock.name: Airlock bypass
airlock.blurb: The airlock's panel is fried. Route the backup cell around the burnt sockets.
airlock.solvedText: The airlock cycles. Somewhere inside, a light comes on.
